purpose: Sources or collections deferred for format, access, or rights review, plus retained sources needing accessibility outreach. Not a second public catalog. No permission to mirror is implied.
lab_questions: Does your ingestion pipeline follow and extract text from linked PDFs, including URLs without a .pdf suffix?
Can it consume bulk CSV and ZIP exports, or does it only crawl HTML?
What explicit licenses or author permissions do you require for text conversion, redistribution, and training?

entries.name: Animal Studies Journal
entries.observation: Two current articles offered abstract pages and full PDFs, both HTTP 200. Sampled articles marked All rights reserved. Format concern, not missing full text.
entries.next_action: Ask labs about PDF ingestion and journal/authors about permission for HTML or plaintext conversion.

entries.name: Between the Species
entries.observation: Public PDFs readable through a web reader, but direct orb requests returned 403. Homepage grants reading, copying, and distribution rights; conversion and training terms need separate review.
entries.next_action: Confirm dependable access and permissions before considering an authorized mirror.

entries.name: Relations: Beyond Anthropocentrism
entries.observation: Current issue PDFs returned 200; HTML viewers only wrap PDFs. Sampled article and PDF specify CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
entries.next_action: Reassess content fit first; seek permission for any conversion or reuse not covered by the license.

entries.name: Canadian Council on Animal Care Guidelines
entries.observation: Guideline listings are HTML; welfare assessment and fish PDFs returned 200. Deferred for PDF-first presentation and overlap with other guidance, not failed access. No affirmative reuse license verified.
entries.next_action: Consider selected guidance if labs ingest PDFs; request permission before mirroring.

entries.name: Rethinking insects as alternative protein
entries.observation: User excluded a single report whose full text is linked as a PDF. Current full-text access was not rechecked in this pass.
entries.next_action: Reconsider scope before investing in accessibility or permission outreach.

entries.name: Wild Animal Welfare Committee publications
entries.observation: Formal documents are mainly PDFs. Public news/commentary provides HTML; the catalog now links the root and HTML commentary.
entries.next_action: Ask about authorized HTML versions of substantive position statements.

entries.name: Josh Milburn
entries.observation: Public bibliography links to a mix of HTML, author manuscripts, sign-in-dependent pages, and embargoed versions. Added two public HTML highlights.
entries.next_action: Ask author about permissible machine-readable copies, retaining version and publisher rights information.

entries.name: Jeff Sebo
entries.observation: HTML summaries with mixed full-text formats. Index retrieval varies by client; a linked Frontiers paper has complete HTML. Added that highlight.
entries.next_action: Ask author about accessible HTML/plaintext versions and permissions for remaining manuscripts.

entries.name: RSPCA Welfare Standards
entries.observation: Full standards and supporting scientific justifications returned 200 as PDFs. Rights remain unverified.
entries.next_action: Ask labs about PDF ingestion; obtain permission before mirroring.

entries.name: Animal Law Review
entries.observation: HTML issue pages give tables of contents; sampled article links returned downloadable PDFs, not full article HTML.
entries.next_action: Revisit selected articles only if format and permission requirements can be satisfied.

entries.name: Global Animal Law
entries.observation: Sampled country pages contain little text and link to PDFs of legislation. Also a content-fit concern, not merely format.
entries.next_action: Reconsider value of legislative material before accessibility outreach.

entries.name: Harvard Animal Law & Policy Program
entries.observation: Publication summaries in HTML; reports primarily PDFs. User opted to remove.
entries.next_action: Consider permission outreach for selected high-value reports, not an indiscriminate mirror.

entries.name: Animal Sentience at WBI Studies Repository
entries.observation: HTML abstracts and metadata are readable; sampled full-text PDF returned Cloudflare verification in HTTP and browser attempts. Journal policy defaults to CC BY with item-level NC exceptions.
entries.next_action: Ask for stable full-text access and confirm article-specific rights.

entries.name: Conservation vs. Wild-Animal Suffering: how can population dynamics help?
entries.observation: Europe PMC does not host full text. Linked bioRxiv preprint was rate-limited from the orb.
entries.next_action: Look for an author-authorized accessible version; establish permission before redistribution.

entries.name: The Ethics of the Ecology of Fear against the Nonspeciesist Paradigm
entries.observation: Record URL returned Cloudflare verification in scripted and browser requests. Full text was not verified.
entries.next_action: Find an accessible publisher or author version and verify rights.

entries.name: Consequentialism and Nonhuman Animals
entries.observation: Record URL returned Cloudflare verification in scripted and browser requests. Full text was not verified.
entries.next_action: Find an accessible publisher or author version and verify rights.
